_comment: Which janko.at puzzles this fork ships, and why the list exists. The generator's gate (unique / line-solvable / fills-its-grid) is a property of the CLUES and cannot see the finished picture at all: a puzzle can pass all three and solve into a scatter of blobs nobody can name. So the keep/drop call is a judgement made by looking, and this file is that judgement, committed so the bank is reproducible. Feed it to import_picross.py --ids.
method: One agent looked at every picture in these batches at ~90px and asked one question: could I name the subject WITHOUT the caption? Recognisable object or scene = keep. Abstract pattern, dense noise, or a shape I could only name after being told = drop. This is a judgement, not a filter: the gate (unique / line-solvable / fills-its-grid) is a property of the CLUES and cannot see the picture at all.
not_judged: 10x10 batches 5,6,7 and 15x15 batches 3,4,6,7 -- 251 of the 531. Rates are measured on the 280 judged, not on the whole corpus.
